newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish newspaper warns beware of the loo.
newsitem.headline: Swedish newspaper warns beware of the loo.

text.p: A Swedish newspaper has issued a warning about a public toilet in its town: you can go but you may not always be able to get out.
The warning was issued by the newspaper Sydostran after two elderly ladies nipped into the lavatory in Karlshamn, in southern Sweden, and were locked in for one and a half hours.
A local locksmith called out to save the day said he had freed four or five people from the same toilet this summer.
A spokesman from the council said the usual toilet attendants were on holiday and no one had been appointed to cover during the summer period.
